items.source: The currentProxy() method is usable if the AOP framework is configured to expose the current proxy (not the default). It returns the AOP proxy in use. Target objects or advice can use this to make advised calls, in the same way as getEJBObject() can be used in EJBs. They can also use it to find advice configuration.
items.translation: `currentProxy()` 方法仅在 AOP 框架配置为暴露当前代理（而非默认行为）时可用。它返回正在使用的 AOP 代理。目标对象或切面可以使用此方法来发出建议调用，方式类似于在 EJB 中使用 `getEJBObject()`。它们还可以使用它来查找切面配置。

items.source:
Spring's AOP framework does not expose proxies by default, as there is a performance cost
in doing so.
items.translation: Spring 的 AOP 框架默认不暴露代理，因为这样做会产生性能开销。

items.source:
The functionality in this class might be used by a target object that needed access
to resources on the invocation. However, this approach should not be used when there is
a reasonable alternative, as it makes application code dependent on usage under AOP and
the Spring AOP framework in particular.
items.translation: 此类中的功能可能会被目标对象使用，该对象需要在调用时访问资源。然而，当存在合理的替代方案时，不应采用此方法，因为它会使应用程序代码依赖于面向切面编程（AOP）的使用，特别是 Spring AOP 框架。

items.source:
Try to return the current AOP proxy. This method is usable only if the
calling method has been invoked via AOP, and the AOP framework has been set
to expose proxies. Otherwise, this method will throw an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 尝试返回当前的 AOP 代理。此方法仅在通过 AOP 调用当前方法且 AOP 框架已配置为暴露代理时可用；否则，此方法将抛出 `IllegalStateException`。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the proxy cannot be found, because the method was invoked outside an AOP invocation context, or because the AOP framework has not been configured to expose the proxy
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果找不到代理，因为方法是在 AOP 调用上下文之外调用的，或者因为 AOP 框架尚未配置为暴露代理
当前的 AOP 代理（永远不会返回null）

items.source: Try to return the current AOP proxy.
items.translation: 尝试返回当前的 AOP 代理。
